examples.label: STANDARD
examples.text: ProdCo will indemnify, defend and hold harmless Amazon and its Affiliates from any losses, costs or damages arising from any third party claims alleging breach of ProdCo representations or warranties.

examples.label: ACCEPTABLE
examples.text: ProdCo shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Amazon and its Affiliates against all losses arising from third party claims related to ProdCo's breach of representations or warranties.

examples.label: ACCEPTABLE
examples.text: ProdCo agrees to indemnify and defend Amazon from any losses or damages resulting from claims by third parties alleging breach of ProdCo's representations, warranties, or obligations under this Agreement.

examples.label: UNACCEPTABLE
examples.text: ProdCo's indemnification obligations shall be limited to direct damages only and shall not exceed the greater of $100,000 or the fees paid under this Agreement in the prior 12 months.

examples.label: UNACCEPTABLE
examples.text: ProdCo shall not be required to indemnify Amazon for any claims arising from Amazon's own negligence or willful misconduct.

examples.label: UNACCEPTABLE
examples.text: Both parties shall mutually indemnify each other for their respective breaches of representations and warranties, with Amazon's indemnification covering ProdCo's indirect and consequential damages.

examples.label: NOT_COVERED
examples.text: In the event of intellectual property infringement claims, the parties shall cooperate in good faith to resolve such claims without assigning indemnification responsibility.
